name: Opacity TF Exploration via Latent Space Projection
definition: A user interface technique for volume rendering exploration that uses a projected latent space of opacity Transfer Functions (TFs) to allow users to browse and select TF variations, synthesizing corresponding volume images to understand feature relationships.
summary: Opacity TF Exploration via Latent Space Projection is a volume rendering interface that enables structured browsing and interpolation of transfer functions by projecting their latent space onto a 2D t-SNE map.
